name: synthetic_execpolicy_selftest_examples
description: Exercises codex-style self-testing rules: match/not_match example invocations are validated at policy load time, and the rule's justification travels with the match (surfaced in the approval reason). The nested-alternatives pattern must stay narrowed (#3091): a degradation to a bare ["git"] prefix would fail load-time validation of the not_match examples.
policy_source:
prefix_rule(
    pattern=["git", ["push", "fetch"]],
    decision="prompt",
    justification="Pushes and fetches contact the remote.",
    match=[["git", "push"], "git fetch origin"],
    not_match=["git status", ["git", "pull"]],
)
prefix_rule(pattern=["git", "status"], decision="allow")
